integrity: Exact full-generator symbolic identities and independent rational stationary solves were checked; all infinite-parameter assertions are supported by the stated algebraic proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a four-site half-filled cycle with one hot bond, three equal-temperature cold bonds and Metropolis exchange rates. It does not establish a thermodynamic phase transition, a general many-site formula, or zero-temperature results. Originality has not been independently or exhaustively certified.
title: Minimal two-bath Kawasaki ring: exact local-order boundary and heat current
